items.title: Drake Finally Makes ‘Take Care’ Bonus Track ‘Hate Sleeping Alone’ Available Across All Streaming Platforms
items.summary:
Drake ‘s genre-shifting sophomore album Take Care turns 11 this weekend (Nov. 15), and to celebrate, he made a fan-favorite loosie/bonus track available on all streaming platforms, with an emphasis on YouTube and Spotify.

Produced by Noah “40” Shebib and featuring background vocals from Trey Songz , “Hate Sleeping Alone” was originally made exclusively available as a bonus track on Take Care ‘s digital edition alongside the Lil Wayne -assisted “The Motto.” Fans are noticeably hyped judging by the comments on YouTube. “This song is the only reason I’ve been using Apple Music for the past five years,” one fan wrote. “Most underrated song in drakes discography I used to pray for times like this,” while another added, “Let’s go, this finally released on Spotify,” in all caps.

The song features the Toronto rapper’s signature style from that era as he seamlessly switches from rapping to singing while lamenting about having to sleep alone over 40’s moody production. “I say I’d rather be with you, but you are not around,” Drake sings on the chorus. “So I’ma call somebody up and see if they’d be down/ ‘Cause I hate sleepin’ alone, I hate sleepin’ alone.”

Speaking of his Take Care era, Drake recently found himself singing along to the title track — which featured Rihanna and went top 10 on the Billboard Hot 100 — on a Kick livestream. He told fans that he’ll probably never perform that song again . “This the only performance you’re getting of this song probably, but s–t, welcome to Trainwreckstv, baby,” he said to the chat.

Check out “Hate Sleeping Alone” below.
items.t: Drake Finally Makes ‘Take Care’ Bonus Track ‘Hate Sleeping Alone’ Available Across All Streaming Platforms

items.title: Ye Settles Lawsuit Over ‘Gun to My Head’ Sample From Descendant of Holocaust Survivors
items.summary:
Ye (formerly Kanye West ) has settled a lawsuit that accused him of sampling a song by German singer-songwriter Alice Merton even though she had rejected clearance due to the rapper’s history of antisemitism.

A Nov. 6 court filing, obtained by Billboard , stated that Ye and Merton have reached a settlement “conditioned on the parties’ completion of certain performance obligations.” Deal terms were not disclosed, and reps for both sides did not immediately return requests for comment.

Related 

A Timeline of the Consequences Ye Has Faced for His ‘WLM’ Shirts & Antisemitic Hate Speech 

CL Signs With THEBLACKLABEL, Reuniting With Longtime Producer Teddy For 'Full Circle' Moment 

Severe Weather, Radius Clauses and Finding the Next Generation of Festival Headliners: 'It's a Year-by-Year Fight to Stay Alive' 

Merton sued Ye last year, alleging his 2024 track “Gun to My Head” sampled her earlier song “Blindside” without permission. Merton said she had expressly denied Ye’s clearance request months earlier because, as a direct descendant of Holocaust survivors, she did not want to be associated with the rapper’s past antisemitic remarks .

Ye’s lawyers argued in response that Merton did not have the proper evidence for a copyright claim. They also pointed out that “Gun to My Head” has never been available on streaming; it was released on a digital deluxe version of Vultures 2 , which was only available for purchase during a two-day period in 2024.

items.title: ‘I Didn’t Want to Become Fat, Bloated, Naked Elvis’: Why KISS Called It Quits on Touring (And What They’re Up to Now)
items.summary:
It’s been nearly three years since KISS played its last concert as a touring act — and in makeup. Now the group is giving fans a look behind the scenes of its End of the Road World Tour, a globe-spanning farewell trek that was bumpier than the KISS camp let on.

The revealing KISS: End of the Road documentary drops Nov. 19 via KISSOnline.com , where it will be available for seven days before moving on to other platforms. The band will preview the film during its KISS Kruise: Land-Locked in Vegas convention Nov. 13-15 at the Virgin Hotel in Las Vegas, where it will also play acoustic and electric concerts and host a tribute to late original guitarist Ace Frehley, who passed away in October 2025 at the age of 74.

KISS’ recent spate of activity also includes the release of box sets celebrating the 50th anniversary of the group’s fifth studio album, Rock and Roll Over, which spent 45 weeks on the Billboard 200 and peaked at No. 11 in 1976. At the same time, the KISS Army is awaiting an avatar show that’s been in the works for several years, as well as a biopic that’s also in process.

“It’s as it should be,” the group’s Paul Stanley tells Billboard via Zoom about KISS’ continuing life after reaching the End of the Road. “KISS is larger than life, and KISS isn’t about the four individuals. It’s about the four persons, the four characters. It’s a timeless thing, so I totally get those four going on. I can get older, but he [Stanley’s Starchild character] won’t.”

Gene Simmons, whom Stanley founded KISS with during 1973 in New York, adds that, “We’ve seen bands that wait too…

But, when Mass Appeal rolled out there “ Legend Has It ” series last year where they released seven albums from seven different legends, Westside was inspired and reached out to Nas and pitched his idea for Heelmatic . I want to be in that legend series before I hang it up because I’m not about to do it later like they did. I’m not about to do it 10-20 years from now like they did. I want to do my s—t now. I’m a legend now. I don’t want to wait till I’m 60 years old for you to tell me I’m a legend. The s—t I done did, nobody has done.”

Heelmatic is a play on Nas’ Illmatic and “Heels,” a brand tied to Gunn’s independent pro wrestling promotion 4th Rope, something that he’ll be more focused on even more as his rap career begins to wind down. “I need new energy,” Gunn explains. “That’s the only way I can stay in this s—t, bro. ‘Cause this s—t is corny. items.title: Raul Malo’s Widow Sues to Stop Remaining Members of The Mavericks from Using Band Name
items.summary:
The widow of Raul Malo , the late frontman of The Mavericks , is suing to stop the Americana band’s remaining members from performing under that name.

Betty Malo filed a lawsuit on Tuesday (Nov. 11) against drummer Paul Deakin, keyboardist Jerry Dale McFadden and guitarist Eddie Perez, who’ve continued to play with guest singers as “The Mavericks & Friends” since Raul’s death from cancer at the end of 2025. Betty says this is prohibited by the band’s operating agreement, which stated that the group could only be called The Mavericks as long as Raul was involved.

Related 

The Mavericks Lead Singer Raul Malo Dead at 60 After Cancer Battle 

CL Signs With THEBLACKLABEL, Reuniting With Longtime Producer Teddy For 'Full Circle' Moment 

Severe Weather, Radius Clauses and Finding the Next Generation of Festival Headliners: 'It's a Year-by-Year Fight to Stay Alive' 

“Accordingly, neither the Mavericks LLC nor the individual Defendants have the right to use the group name — the Mavericks — unless Raul Malo is a member of the LLC, or Betty Malo, as the personal representative of the estate of Raul Malo and a holder of 35% of the financial rights in the LLC, gives her consent,” reads the lawsuit, obtained by Billboard .

Deakin, McFadden and Perez have said the goal of The Mavericks & Friends project is “honoring their beloved Raul Malo while building upon the legacy he helped create.” Legally speaking, their attorneys claim this is allowed because they amended the operating agreement after Raul’s death to remove the restrictive language.

Betty, however, argues in her lawsuit…

items.title: Rosalía makes history with Album Of The Year award win at Latin Grammys and performs ‘Lux’ medley
items.summary:
Rosalía has made history at the 2026 Latin Grammy Awards, winning Album Of The Year for the third time and playing a medley of songs from ‘Lux’ – watch below.

READ MORE: Rosalía live in London: a breathtakingly brilliant work of art 

The Spanish star was among the biggest winners at the 27th annual ceremony, which took place at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas last night (November 12).

She claimed the night’s biggest prize for ‘Lux (Complete Works)’, becoming the first woman to win Album Of The Year three times as a lead artist, following her previous victories for ‘El Mal Querer’ in 2019 and ‘Motomami’ in 2022.

The achievement places her alongside Alejandro Sanz and Juanes, who have also won the category three times. Only Juan Luis Guerra has won it more often, with four victories.

Rosalía was visibly emotional as she accepted the award from Juanes, recalling how the Colombian musician had supported her at the beginning of her career, attending concerts in Madrid when she was performing to audiences of around 100 people.

Addressing the audience in Spanish, she reflected on the creative risks behind her three award-winning albums.

“This is the third time I’ve won this award, and — just as ‘El Mal Querer’ felt like a dream, or ‘Motomami’ was a gamble — ‘Lux’ has been, for me, a leap into the void,” she said.

“I believe it’s very important to speak your own truth and for others to be able to speak theirs; this album is my truth.”

She also thanked the people who had supported her artistic vision, as well as reflecting on those who had previously dismissed her…
items.t: Rosalía makes history with Album Of The Year award win at Latin Grammys and performs ‘Lux’ medley

items.title: Blink-182’s Travis Barker quit smoking after being “diagnosed with precancer of the oesophagus”
items.summary:
Blink-182 drummer Travis Barker has revealed that he quit smoking after being diagnosed with precancer of the oesophagus.

During a recent episode of the Big Bro With Kid Cudi podcast, the musician opened up about the time he decided to adopt a “healthier” lifestyle over 20 years ago.

READ MORE:  Blink-182 – ‘One More Time’ review: a surprisingly touching reunion 

“I was like, ‘Oh, man, I’m having a son,” he said, referring to his first son, Landon, born in 2003. “So I started running to the freeway and back. I didn’t really know what I was doing – I was just like, ‘I gotta be healthy, I gotta be a badass dad!”

Barker went on to recall his past decision to “start balancing out” some of his “bad” habits with the “good” ones. He said getting more exercise also “helped [him] stay sober” from drugs.

“My running started getting bigger and more important to me than smoking,” he continued. “[…] It’s like therapy.”

As for his decision to stop smoking weed and cigarettes altogether, Barker shared: “I only quit because I got diagnosed with precancer of the oesophagus. ‘Cause I loved blunts and I would smoke too much. So that was the only [reason].”

The drummer said he asked his doctor if he was “serious” about the diagnosis. “He’s like, ‘This is your warning shot, Trav. Don’t fuck around. You’ve got to stop smoking’. Or I would’ve never stopped.

“I thought I could be like Willie Nelson and smoke to the day I die, you know?”.

But the drummer admitted that he still “misses” smoking. Watch the full interview in the video above.

items.t: Blink-182’s Travis Barker quit smoking after being “diagnosed with precancer of the oesophagus”

items.title: Check out Dolly Parton’s “traditional country version” of new U2 duet ‘Torn’
items.summary:
A “traditional country version” of Dolly Parton ‘s final recorded song, a duet with U2 titled ‘Torn’, has been released alongside the band’s new album – listen to both versions below.

READ MORE: U2: “You have to up your game when people step into the room like Fontaines D.C.” 

The emotional ballad closes U2’s 16th studio album ‘Carnaval De Luz’ , which is out today (November 13), and features the late country star trading vocals with Bono .

An alternative recording, titled ‘Torn (Kent Wells Version)’, also arrived today, having received its premiere on US country radio yesterday (November 12). The version takes a more traditional country approach to the song, in contrast to the atmospheric arrangement on U2’s album.

The two recordings offer contrasting settings for Parton’s final vocal performance, with her distinctive voice at the centre of a song about family relationships fractured by political divisions.

Listen to both versions of ‘Torn’ here:

Speaking to The Sun , Bono explained the differences between the recordings, saying: “We did something similar with Johnny Cash. If you think about Larry’s drum part, it’s more of a sci-fi country landscape.”

“I think he did her a favour by not doing the obvious but it was risky. If she didn’t run with it — and she’d have no problem telling you — then we’d have lost her.

“But she liked the direction we took it and her camp has a more traditional country version, which they’re going to put out.

“Hearing her voice in the context of ‘Carnaval De Luz’ is a bit of a shock and a welcome one.”

The track was co-written by U2,…
items.t: Check out Dolly Parton’s “traditional country version” of new U2 duet ‘Torn’

items.title: Violet Grohl shares “dystopian” new song ‘Metal Birds’ from ‘The Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping’
items.summary:
Violet Grohl has shared a new song, ‘Metal Birds’, from the soundtrack to The Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping . Listen below.

The slow-burning, atmospheric track arrived today (Friday November 13), ahead of the sixth film in the Hunger Games franchise, which hits cinemas on November 20.

It marks the first material from Grohl since dropping her acclaimed debut studio album, ‘Be Sweet To Me’ , in May.

“Writing ‘Metal Birds’ was one of the most special songwriting experiences for me,” she explained. “I’ve loved the [ Hunger Games ] movies and the book series since I was a kid, so it was a total honour to be asked to write a song about a story that I feel so connected to.

“It opened up the world of dystopian themes for me. I found the visuals in the movie to be so striking and strong and important to the plot that I felt like I needed to include them in the song.”

She added: “And I took mental notes of lots of things I had seen, and they really stuck with me. And so the songwriting process came really easily and was really fun.”

Produced by Justin Raisen and Lewis Pesacov, ‘Metal Birds’ finds Grohl singing over a moody, stripped-back instrumental: “ Metal birds in the sky/ Come and take me away/ Generator, power breaker / Look at me through the embers .”

Later in the song, the simple electric guitar work is accompanied by some increasingly lush orchestral elements. “ Kiss you with a smile/ Death hung around my neck ,” Grohl adds. “ Let’s leave it for a while/ I’ll lay the flowers on your chest/ Open eyes are for the weeping .”

Out today, ‘The Hunger Games: Sunrise…

The global tour will launch in June next year, with more than 150 performances planned across nearly 50 cities in 2027 and 2028. The first leg will take in North America, the UK and Europe, with further dates in Asia and Latin America to be announced.

The concerts will bring the animated HUNTR/X characters Rumi, Mira and Zoey to life through cutting-edge technology, with creators promising an immersive experience that combines live performers, stunts, choreography and audience participation.

Characters including the Saja Boys and Derpy Tiger will also feature, alongside music from the hugely successful Netflix film, including the Oscar-winning hit ‘Golden’ .

It is not confirmed whether the singers behind HUNTR/X – EJAE, Audrey Nuna and Rei Ami – will perform live at the shows. The trio have previously performed ‘Golden’ together at events including the BAFTAs .

Marian Lee, Netflix’s Chief Marketing Officer, said: “ KPop Demon Hunters has transformed from a breakout hit into a generational phenomenon — sustaining 63 consecutive weeks in Netflix’s Global Top 10, eclipsing 2 billion Spotify streams for ‘Golden,’ and breaking the all-time record for the longest running soundtrack at No. 1 on Billboard’s Top Soundtracks chart.”

items.title: ‘GTA 6’ physical copies have been delivered – and fans are “pretty disappointed”
items.summary:
Grand Theft Auto 6 fans who pre-ordered the physical version of the game have started to receive their copies in the mail – and many have been left disappointed.

READ MORE: Every song confirmed for the ‘Grand Theft Auto 6’ soundtrack so far 

Grand Theft Auto 6 officially launches next week (November 19) and fans have been able to pre-load the game since Tuesday (November 10) so they can dive into Vice City as soon as the game goes live.

While Rockstar Games aren’t making any physical discs for Grand Theft Auto 6 , fans have been able to pre-order physical boxes that contain a download code – and they’ve started to be delivered. 

Some fans were excited about the new screenshots on the back of the physical box but others aren’t impressed that the only other thing inside the physical edition of Grand Theft Auto 6 is a double-sided poster. The freebie features the game’s artwork but, unlike previous editions of GTA , there is no version of the map.

“No map is actually pretty disappointing,” wrote one Reddit user. “What is even the point of physical editions if we don’t even get maps? Will they add maps to editions sent out after launch,” said another. “It’s fucking crazy how we don’t get much now. I loved going through the maps and instruction booklets that games used to have,” added a third. “Yeah I regret buying the ‘physical’ edition,” wrote another fan.

Sure, we aren't getting a disc for GTA 6, but at least Rockstar Games made sure to pack the physical box with various artworks and screenshots. This is going to feel so nostalgic 10 years from now.…
items.t: ‘GTA 6’ physical copies have been delivered – and fans are “pretty disappointed”

items.title: Stevie Wonder defends Macklemore in call for freedom of speech in Glasgow: “Ban me if you want”
items.summary:
Stevie Wonder has shared his support for Macklemore while on stage in Glasgow, calling for freedom of speech and saying the people can “ban me if you want”.

The legendary singer, songwriter and pianist made the comments while performing at the OVO Hydro arena in Glasgow on Wednesday (November 11), as part of his ongoing tour celebrating 50 years of classic album ‘Songs In The Key Of Life’ .

Shortly after kicking off the 24-song setlist with ‘Love’s in Need of Love Today’ and ‘Have a Talk With God’, the R&B icon addressed the audience and gave an impassioned speech calling for freedom of speech.

The speech was particularly poignant on the night as the show was held on Remembrance Day, and in his comments, Wonder said that he and his daughter Aisha Morris – who was also a backing vocalist on the night – had been speaking about Macklemore, and how he was abruptly kicked off Ed Sheeran’s ‘Loop Tour’ after calling for a “Free Palestine” while on-stage.

Stevie Wonder comes out in support of Macklemore: "We want wars to stop."

Lauren Hunter pic.twitter.com/J5KSB2czZL 

— Far Out Magazine (@FarOutMag) November 12, 2026 

“As with all of us that are artists, musicians, people feel this way,” Wonder explained. “We want wars to stop everywhere. We want every person in life to be protected from the destruction of war.”

Amid cheers from the crowd, he continued: “Ban me as you want. I’m only speaking the words that are given to me by the most high, our God. Let’s bring peace to the world.”

Macklemore was booted from Sheeran’s tour earlier this year, after his on-stage…
items.t: Stevie Wonder defends Macklemore in call for freedom of speech in Glasgow: “Ban me if you want”

items.title: Muse debut new songs live and premiere ambitious new stage show as they kick off ‘The Wow! Signal’ 2026 UK arena tour in Manchester
items.summary:
Muse have kicked off their huge ‘The Wow! Signal’ 2026 arena tour in Manchester, and broken out some of their new songs live for the first time, backed by an epic new stage show. Check out footage and the setlist below.

READ MORE: Matt Bellamy on rediscovering his own muse: “I can’t live without music – that feeling came back to me on this album” 

The dates come following the trio dropping their  acclaimed 10th album ‘The Wow! Signal ‘ back in June, and heading on the road over the summer with a run of North American shows .

Now, they have kicked off the first of their UK and European arena tour dates – which they promised ahead of time would feature much more ambitious production planned. 

Launched at the Co-op Live arena in Manchester last night (Thursday November 12), Matt Bellamy and co opened their 15-song set with three ‘Wow! Signal’ tracks: ‘Hexagon’, ‘The Sickness In You & I’ and ‘Unravelling’.

‘Hexagon’ and ‘Unravelling’ made their way into the setlist following them being debuted at the US shows, and ‘The Sickness In You & I’ was broken out for the first time live at the Manchester gig.
